newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lehman builds Asia research, trading teams.
newsitem.headline: Lehman builds Asia research, trading teams.

text.p: Lehman Brothers has boosted its Asian equity research departments and has begun to build a convertible bond trading team, the company said Monday.
Two senior analysts have been added to Lehman's India equity research effort. Piyush Mubayi has joined from W.I. Carr in India and Sandeep Dixit has joined from Peregrine Capital India.
Initially, both analysts will be based in Hong Kong.
Patrick Chau has joined Lehman Brothers' equity research department from SBC Warburg to expand the firm's coverage of the Asian property sector.
Alauddin Ahmed has been appointed vice president Asian Convertible Bond and Arbitrage Trading. Ahmed previously worked for Salomon Brothers.
